messages:
Maya: Quick sync — launching the 'Code Starter' prompt pack pilot next week. Need a short launch benchmark narrative + webinar + inbound routing plan. Goal: convert 10% of new trial signups to active prompt usage within 7 days. Ideas?
Jordan: Love the goal. Hypothesis: show measurable time-to-prototype wins in the benchmark post + pair with a low-friction webinar. Routing idea: auto-invite new signups who run the sample prompt.
Sam: A/B test two launch post angles: (1) technical bench (latency/cost per prompt) and (2) product story (first feature built in 15 minutes). Short copy only.
Li: Tracking: we'll need events: `prompt_pack_invite_shown`, `starter_prompt_used`, `starter_conversion_7d`. Add UTM params utm_campaign=starter-pilot. I can wire the Amplitude funnel.
Nora: Creative: deliver two hero images (bench chart + dev workflow) and a 30s clip for social. Also recommend a short benchmark screenshot with tokens/latency called out.
Jordan: Webinar format: 20m demo + 15m Q&A, record for on-demand. Keep it practical: 3 real prompts, show cost/latency tradeoffs. Can we auto-add folks who used a starter prompt to the webinar roster?
Sam: I can present the demo — will prepare 3 prompts (onboarding, rewrite, scaffolding). Need a landing copy draft and calendar description.
Maya: Timelines: landing + webinar copy by EOD tomorrow, assets by Fri. Routing: prefer product nudge auto-enroll, fallback to Zapier if needed. Also set a soft cap on free credits to avoid abuse.
Li: For rollout we'll tag cohorts: `pilot_2026_starter` and pass that to analytics. Quick tracking snippet for engineers:
```
// Amplitude event example
{ event: 'starter_prompt_used', user_id: '123', props: { template: 'starter-js', cohort: 'pilot_2026' } }
```
I can also stub the funnel dashboard.
Nora: I'll sketch the two hero variants and a small GIF of the prompt flow. Will post assets to Figma by Thursday.
Jordan: Proposal: cap pilot to first 500 signups, 50 free-credits/org, and TTL for credits = 14 days. Keeps economics contained.
Maya: Decision: cap 500 signups, 50 credits/org. Owners: Sam -> landing + prompt templates, Li -> tracking & funnel, Nora -> creative, Jordan -> rollout & limits, Maya -> overall PM + comms.
Sam: Landing copy draft (quick): "Build a feature with 3 prompts in 15 minutes — try Code Starter with a free sample pack. Join our live demo to see it in action." Will push full draft to the doc.
Li: I'll create the Amplitude funnel and tag the experiment `starter_pilot_v1`. Zapier fallback: I can push calendar registrations for anyone who triggers `starter_prompt_used` and isn't auto-enrolled.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: campaign 'starter-pilot-email-v1' scheduled for 2026-09-15T17:00:00Z (draft created).
Maya: Ok—sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to confirm assets + finalize routing. Quick reactions: please :thumbsup: if you can own assigned action.
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Li: :thumbsup:
Nora: :thumbsup:
